value.rationale: The exact seven-vertex three-domination graph-property complex is a natural case immediately beyond the classified domination-number filtrations of arXiv:1901.07130 and the previously established D_{6,3} computation. The complete finite mod-two classification reveals four occupied homological degrees, informing the intrinsic topology and constraining future homotopy or integer-homology investigations without inventing a general theorem.
